item.tib: rig 'dzin dgongs 'dus kyi 'khrid rim sngon 'gro'i tshig bshad byang chub lam gyi 'phrang sel
item.coloph: rig 'dzin gsang sgrub rgyud las drangs (drang) don 'khrid (khrid) rim gter 'byon du tshangs yang / tshigs (tshig) bshad bskor 'go tshangs (tshang) mi 'dug pas skal ldan 'ga' la 'khrid du 'chad rtsom 'kho gal du byung bas/ chu phag chu zla'i rdzogs pa chen por spyod pa'i nyin du / gzhung sa chen po'i bsdu rim thun mtshams su kho bo rig 'dzin kun grol gsang ba brtsal gyis bsgrigs ste (te) brtsams pa 'di skal ldan gsum gyi bsgrub sla la sogs bde ba 'byin myur ba'i ched du yin gyi nyams su len par mdzod cig zhal da dang bcas ste (te) sa ma yA///
